title: Climate policies neglect risks posed by legacy landfills | Science
description: The environmental hazards associated with legacy landfills can be devastating, and the risks are being intensified by climate change. In August, extreme overnight precipitation compromised the structuralintegrity of the Dar es Salam landfill in Guinea, which had been scheduled to close, causing a landslide that buried homes and killed at least 30 people (1). Earlier this summer, in July, extreme dry-season heat ignited methane pockets in Indonesia’s Jatiwaringin landfill, a legacy open dump, sparking a 10-day fire across 15 hectares (2).
